tasks.title: Create Knowledge Base Manager skill
tasks.description: Build a unified skill for managing structured knowledge across RAG and graph systems. This skill provides comprehensive guidance for knowledge base design, implementation, curation, and maintenance. Addresses the gap discovered between RAG (documents) and Knowledge Graphs (entities) by providing a holistic knowledge management methodology.
acceptance_criteria: Skill provides clear guidance on when to use KB vs RAG vs Graph
Covers knowledge curation, validation, and versioning
Has concrete examples and code snippets
Integrates with existing rag-implementer and knowledge-graph-builder skills
archon_workflow: 5. Implement: Create SKILL.md with comprehensive methodology

tasks.title: Build knowledge-base-mcp server
tasks.description: Create MCP server providing CRUD operations for knowledge entries, versioning, validation, source tracking, and conflict resolution. This MCP makes knowledge management executable rather than just advisory. Supports both document-based (RAG) and entity-based (graph) knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Supports both document and entity knowledge types
archon_workflow: 4. Invoke: api-designer (for tool design), data-engineer (for storage)
5. Implement: Build MCP server with 8 tools
